This is the seventh public release candidate of the NPMplus Security Fork. It is intended for test servers before a stable release.

### What changed since RC6

- Reconciled the full upstream develop through `bb347a39` (the scheduled upstream-sync automation had stopped fail-closed on 42 conflicted files, so the integration was done manually). The frontend is now plain JavaScript: upstream removed the TypeScript toolchain (tsconfig, `tsc` build step, and the typescript/`@types` devDependencies), and the remaining fork TypeScript sources run through Node 24 native type stripping. Frontend behavior is unchanged.
- Adopted upstream's simplified permission model (`isAdmin`/`canAdmin()`/`canUser()`/`can()`/visibility) and the nginx control API: config reloads now go through the internal `/run/nginx-control.sock` unix socket instead of running `nginx -s reload`. Nicknames are server-managed now and no longer part of API payloads.
- All fork security invariants are preserved and re-verified: an anonymous missing session is still a 403 at route permission checks (not upstream's 401), rejected sessions stay 401, the login/refresh/OIDC rate limiters, the bounded gravatar fetch, and the one-time setup-token gate are unchanged, and upstream's open setup endpoint was not taken. The CI security-invariant guardrails and the full test suites pass on the tagged commit.
- The image build carries the upstream lua-nginx-module v0.10.32rc5 and resolver_conf_parsing 1.31.6 bumps. Upstream dependency bumps that arrived younger than the pnpm `minimumReleaseAge` supply-chain window (`react-intl` 12, `markdown-to-jsx` 9.10.3) were rejected and stay on the reviewed versions until they age past the window.

### Install or update a test VM

Copy and paste the complete command:

```bash
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.7/setup-npmplus.sh &&
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.7/setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sha256sum -c setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sudo bash setup-npmplus.sh
```

Choose **Install NPMplus** for a fresh test VM or **Safe update** for an existing installer-managed test VM. Safe update repairs known configuration drift before the normal snapshot, health-checking, and automatic rollback protection. Existing RC6 test VMs should switch to this release before their next maintenance window. This is a routine update: the database migrations (including the nickname backfill) run automatically and no manual steps are required.

Please report problems through [GitHub issues](https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/issues). Report security vulnerabilities privately through the repository Security page.
